kpis.label: Reality Coverage
kpis.help: Share of monitored property facts and attributes reflected in AI answers.

executiveAssessment.text: The St. Regis Mexico City currently shows AI Consideration of 85.7% and Scenario Presence of 100.0%, with Reality Coverage at 53.8%. Strongest governed signal: Often placed near the top when AI ranks hotels. Primary constraint: No single dominant weakness. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +85.7 pp and Scenario Presence +100.0 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 6 with Portfolio AI Presence 85.7%. Independent Positioning is also strong and does not contradict the Core read; benchmark and index remain suppressed while the peer set stays below five hotels. Overall Core performance remains strong; weakness, where present, is concentrated rather than broad. Management should protect demonstrated strengths, review concentrated attribute gaps, and watch competitive displacement where it already appears in evidence.

actionAgenda.actionTitle: Stand up a TripAdvisor management-response program with owner, SLA, and theme tracking — focus: designate accountable owner, set response SLA, identify recurring complaint themes monthly
actionAgenda.observedIssue: TripAdvisor appears in 64.1% of cited sources in the current monitoring period (41 citations), making response quality and factual corrections operationally material when misconceptions appear.
actionAgenda.recommendedAction: Confirm the hotel’s canonical facts for TripAdvisor responses with the accountable owner (The St. Regis Mexico City). Complete the applicable checklist items: designate accountable owner; set response SLA (property-configured; do not invent a default unless governed); identify recurring complaint themes monthly; correct factual misconceptions where appropriate; track response rate. Audit each target source and record current wording/state: TripAdvisor. Correct only the sources where facts are missing, conflicting, or outdated. Do not change measurement methodology. Store completion evidence (canonical policy summary, sources reviewed, sources corrected, URLs/screenshots, completion date). Notify Dealality of completion so the next monitoring period can check the expected signal without assuming causation.
